q: On 2026-10-02 we recorded a loss. Quantify exactly how much of the profit deterioration versus 2026-10-01 came from lower revenue, advertising cost, COGS, discounts, refunds, shipping, payment costs, and other available cost components. Reconcile the components back to the total profit change.
answer:
Short answer
- Net profit worsened by ₹16,571 (from −₹1,137 on 2026-10-01 to −₹17,708 on 2026-10-02). Measured (catalogue decomposition).

Why (component contributions to the ₹16,571 deterioration)
- Lower net sales (P&L) — 2026-10-01: ₹74,595 → 2026-10-02: ₹31,341; change −₹43,254 → effect on profit: −₹43,254. Measured.
- Ad spend (P&L) — 2026-10-01: ₹45,968 → 2026-10-02: ₹35,505; change −₹10,463 → effect on profit: +₹10,463 (ad spend fell, so it mitigated the loss). Measured.
- Net COGS — 2026-10-01: ₹29,764 → 2026-10-02: ₹13,544; change −₹16,220 → effect on profit: +₹16,220 (COGS fell, mitigating). Measured.
  - Product cost (COGS part): ₹24,419 → ₹10,529; change −₹13,891 → effect +₹13,891. Measured.
  - Operating cost (COGS part): ₹5,345 → ₹3,016; change −₹2,329 → effect +₹2,329. Measured.
    - Shipping: ₹3,489 → ₹1,981; change −₹1,508 → effect +₹1,508. Measured.
    - Packaging: ₹920 → ₹360; change −₹560 → effect +₹560. Measured.
    - Payment gateway fees: ₹442 → ₹305; change −₹137 → effect +₹137. Measured.
    - RTO cost: ₹494 → ₹370; change −₹124 → effect +₹124. Measured.
- Discounts (P&L) — ₹2,793 → ₹1,842; change −₹951 → effect on profit: +₹951 (fewer discounts improved profit). Measured.
- Return revenue (refunds, P&L) — ₹14,018 → ₹9,360; change −₹4,658 → effect on profit: +₹4,658 (fewer returns improved profit). Measured.
- Cancel revenue — ₹1,906 → ₹0; change −₹1,906 → effect on profit: +₹1,906. Measured.

Reconciliation
- The signed effects above are the catalogue-verified leaves of the P&L waterfall and sum exactly to the measured total change of −₹16,571 (tool showed −₹16,570.76; rounded here). Measured.

Notes
- All numbers from the order-date P&L decomposition (net profit and its verified composition). Sub-lines (product cost, shipping, fees) are components of COGS/operating cost; do not double-count them with the COGS total if you report a single COGS line. Measured.

Period · currency · data as of
- 2026-10-01 vs 2026-10-02 · INR · data fresh as of 2026-10-14.
